cases.title: Prove Upgrade rollback

Copy it to /var/lib/omahab/test-releases/unhealthy in the disposable guest.
Run sudo omahab system upgrade --flake path:/var/lib/omahab/test-releases/unhealthy.
expected: The unhealthy switch fails its health gate and automatically restores the previous generation.
/up, reported version, and persisted data verify afterward.
